clue.text: Against Jack helping holocaust

parts.note: a con is an argument against, as in pros and cons
the Union Jack is a flag
a helping of food is a ration

explanation.surface: Someone opposing a man named Jack who helped in a great disaster.
explanation.walkthrough: Jack is the Union Jack, Britain's national flag, not a man's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A holocaust in its older sense is a huge destructive fire, which is a synonym for a great blaze.

clue.text: Tailor is abroad, getting more qualified

parts.note: to be out is to be away, abroad
fitter is the comparative of fit, suitable or qualified

explanation.surface: A dressmaker is overseas, gaining better skills.
explanation.definitionFit: A clothier who supplies and fits clothes is a tailor or seller of garments.

clue.text: Keep Henry away

parts.note: a keep is the stronghold of a castle, a fort
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: An instruction to keep a man named Henry at a distance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Keep' looks like a verb but is a castle stronghold.
explanation.definitionFit: Away as in onwards or out, as in the phrase 'go forth'.

clue.text: First person overseeing worker is determined

indicators.note: in a down clue the overseeing piece sits above the other

parts.note: Adam was the first man in the Bible
a worker ant

explanation.surface: The original man supervising a labourer is resolute.
explanation.definitionFit: Determined means immovable in purpose, a synonym for unyielding.

clue.text: Building worker upset about new items for hire

indicators.note: the turned piece goes around the other
in a down clue upset turns the word upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: a slater lays roof slates

explanation.surface: A roofer is distressed about new things to rent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' reverses SLATER to RETALS, which goes 'about' N.
explanation.definitionFit: Things hired out for a fee are leased goods, a plural noun for lettings.

clue.text: Rested ten in organisation? Most kind!

indicators.note: organising letters rearranges them into a new order

explanation.surface: Ten people were rested in a company; how generous!
explanation.definitionFit: Most kind is the superlative of gentle, loving or soft-hearted.

clue.text: Believe person is without a relationship

indicators.note: without means outside, so one piece is around the other

parts.note: one means a person, as in 'one should'
pi is a ratio, a relationship between circumference and diameter

explanation.surface: Someone thinks a person is single.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like lacking but means outside.
explanation.definitionFit: To believe something is to hold it as an opinion, to state a view.

clue.text: Hide clothing and grub

parts.note: hide is animal skin, leather
a jacket is an item of clothing

explanation.surface: Concealing one's garments and food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grub' looks like food but is the larva sense.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the larva of the crane fly, a grub that lives in soil.

clue.text: Cleaner in panic, when harbouring the rudest criminal

indicators.note: harbouring holds something within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: panic is a fit of fear

indicators.note: criminal means wrong or bad, so the letters are put into a bad order

explanation.surface: A cleaner in alarm while sheltering a very coarse villain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'criminal' rearranges THE RUDEST into THERDUSTE, held by FEAR; 'in' and 'when' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A tool of plumes on a stick for wiping away dirt is a cleaning implement.

clue.text: Intern ate stew in harbour

indicators.note: to stew is to churn about in a pot, so these letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A trainee had a meal of stew at a port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stew' looks like the food eaten, but it is the anagram signal on INTERN ATE; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To harbour a thought or feeling is to hold it in mind, as one may entertain an idea.

clue.text: Simple to be the first person in the body of the church

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other, as the person stands within the church

parts.note: the nave is the main central part of a church building
I is the first-person singular pronoun

explanation.surface: Being the first to stand in the church's main hall is an easy matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Simple in the sense of unsophisticated or innocent, a synonym for credulous.

clue.text: Taxidermist initially given rotting body part

indicators.note: initially picks out just the opening letter of the following word

parts.note: game meat left to rot is said to be high

explanation.surface: A taxidermist is handed a decomposing piece of an animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The upper part of the leg, from hip to knee, is a part of the body.

clue.text: Meant assembly to go round labyrinth in wonder

indicators.note: one piece surrounds the other, the outer piece going around it
an assembly puts parts together in a new arrangement, so these letters are rebuilt

parts.note: a labyrinth is a maze

explanation.surface: A gathering was meant to tour a maze in awe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembly' looks like a gathering of people but is the anagram signal, making AMENT; 'to go round' wraps that around the labyrinth.
explanation.definitionFit: Wonder as a feeling of great surprise is a synonym for astonishment.

clue.text: Caught after no ball when cutting

indicators.note: one piece comes after the other in the answer

parts.note: a no ball concedes an extra run in cricket
CT is a cricket scoring abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A batter is caught off a no ball while playing a cut shot.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a no ball is an illegal delivery that gives the batting side an extra run; 'when' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutting from a newspaper is a passage taken out of it, an excerpt.

clue.text: Designer makes Catholic dose with ecstasy during play

indicators.note: these pieces happen during, so sit inside, the other

parts.note: an act is a part of a play, or performing
RC means Roman Catholic
a hit is a dose of a drug
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A designer gives a Catholic a drug dose and ecstasy during a show.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who designs buildings is the professional who plans them.

clue.text: Notice attendant dripping

parts.note: to notice is to see
a page is a young attendant

explanation.surface: Spot the servant who is leaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Dripping as a noun means slow leaking of liquid, a synonym for leakage.

clue.text: Lots roll into a ball

indicators.note: one piece goes into the other

parts.note: a ball is a formal dance
a bun is a bread roll

explanation.surface: Lots of people roll into a ball.
explanation.walkthrough: 'roll' looks like a verb but is a bread roll; 'ball' is a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: Lots means a great quantity, a synonym for plenty.

clue.text: Judge's heroic, if agitated, in Palestine

parts.note: J is the abbreviation for judge; the 's stands for is

indicators.note: agitated means stirred up, so the letters of the word are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: A judge is brave, though nervous, while in the Holy Land.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient city near the Jordan lies in the region historically called Palestine.

clue.text: Work on an inlay that's iridescent

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
to line something is to set a lining or inlay into it

explanation.surface: Work on a decorative inlay that shimmers.
explanation.definitionFit: Iridescent means having shifting colours like an opal, a gemstone.

clue.text: Startle team leader dropped into a well

indicators.note: one piece falls inside the other, like a bucket down a shaft

parts.note: sound means healthy or well

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Shock the squad by having their captain fall down a well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'well' looks like a water shaft but means healthy, SOUND.
explanation.definitionFit: To startle is to shock or amaze someone greatly.

clue.text: Woman in advancing years becomes mean

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: age is advancing years
Vera is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A woman growing old becomes stingy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mean' looks like stingy but is the statistical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The mean of a set is its arithmetic typical value, the norm.

clue.text: Blast shy Indian opener's wicket

parts.note: a shy is a throw, as at a coconut shy, and so is a cast

indicators.note: an opener comes first, so this takes the first letter of the word

parts.note: a wicket is a small gate

explanation.surface: A timid Indian batsman's stumps are blown away.
explanation.walkthrough: A coconut shy is a British fairground stall where balls are thrown; here shy means throw. Wicket is the gate sense, not cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: To blast someone is to criticise severely, a synonym for rebuke harshly.

clue.text: Angry about Tory account

indicators.note: about places one piece around the other

parts.note: sore means angry in American usage
C stands for Conservative, the Tory party

explanation.surface: Someone is cross about a Conservative's version of events.
explanation.definitionFit: On that account means on that ground, as in on that point; also a reckoning or tally.

clue.text: Pluto gets sunglasses off first

indicators.note: the opening letter is taken off the word

parts.note: shades is slang for sunglasses

explanation.surface: Pluto removes his dark glasses before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: Pluto was the Roman god of the underworld, the Greek realm of the dead bearing the same name.

clue.text: Bear queen to vacillate

parts.note: to bear a child is to have one
R stands for regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A bear and a queen hesitate.
explanation.definitionFit: To vacillate is to waver or hesitate, a Scottish and Northern dialect sense.

clue.text: Arouse approval in a girl

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: Eve is a girl's name
OK signals approval

explanation.surface: A young woman stirs feelings when she gives her consent.
explanation.definitionFit: To arouse a memory or feeling is to call it up, a synonym for summon.

clue.text: Notice vehicle in popular church beforehand

indicators.note: the first pair of pieces goes inside the second pair

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
CE is the Church of England
an ad is a notice advertising something
a van is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A poster on a van parked in a well-attended church ahead of time.
explanation.definitionFit: Beforehand means ahead of time, the idiom for doing something early.

clue.text: Kind but eccentric theatre legend

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so the letters are put out of their usual order

explanation.surface: A stage star who is benevolent but odd.
explanation.definitionFit: Kind and soft in feeling, a compound meaning compassionate.
